title: 2002 HMMT February General Round 1 Problem 3
statement: How many triples \((A, B, C)\) of positive integers (positive integers are the numbers \(1,2,3,4, \ldots\) ) are there such that \(A+B+C=10\), where order does not matter (for instance the triples \((2,3,5)\) and \((3,2,5)\) are considered to be the same triple) and where two of the integers in a triple could be the same (for instance \((3,3,4)\) is a valid triple).
